content:
Ivanovo State University, also known as IvSU, is a public higher education institution located in Ivanovo, a major city to the northeast of Moscow, Russia. It was established on May 21st, 1918. It's considered to be one of the oldest universities in the region.

The university offers a variety of programs for undergraduate, graduate, and postgraduate students. The educational fields at IvSU include Humanities, Social Sciences, Natural Sciences, IT, Engineering, and Economics, among others. The teaching staff consists of over 900 members trained in different scientific and educational spheres.

The Ivanovo State University is organized into several faculties; these include Faculty of Chemistry, Faculty of Physics and Technology, Faculty of Law, Faculty of History, Faculty of Mathematics and Information Technology, Faculty of Art and Cultural Studies, and Faculty of Pedagogics and Psychology, etc.

The university campus contains multiple buildings designed to provide housing, athletic facilities, as well as space for educational and scientific purposes. It provides students and staff with a library of over 1 million volumes, offering not only educational resources but also an extensive collection of classical and modern literature.

IvSU is an active participant in international academic mobility programs. It maintains partnerships with universities and scientific institutions from different countries. The university is also a member of the Association of Russian Leading Universities and Eurasian Universities Association. 

In terms of research, the Ivanovo State University carries out scientific projects in natural, technical, social sciences, and humanities departments, and maintains a number of research laboratories. 

IvSU students have opportunities to take part in various cultural, social and sports activities. The university has several creative student groups, a sports complex, and organizes events and contests regularly. 

Admission into Ivanovo State University is contingent upon passing an entrance exam, which can be competitive due to the university's high reputation within the country. 

As of 2021, Aleksandr Arguchinskiy serves as the Rector of the university.
